page.overview:
Who is Litten Smitten?

Litten Smitten is a teenage girl with short black hair and bright yellow eyes. She wears an overall hooded jacket that resembles Nidothing, donned with different badges and logos, a black skirt, black socks with purple diamond logos, and a pair of black sneakers with red accents. She also carries a purple-and-black backpack.

During one of Nidothing's live-streams, Litten Smitten accidentally lied about seeing the black Rayquaza after seeing that Nidothing's stream lacked comments. When meeting Liko and Roy, Litten Smitten was initially enthusiastic to meet fellow Nidothing fans, though she said that if she couldn't meet Nidothing, she wouldn't be revealing anything. But she soon became hostile when she learned that they were associated with the Rising Volt Tacklers.

Litten Smitten then challenged Liko and her Meowscarada to a battle, because she herself said she wouldn't trust anyone who had destroyed Mount Pericap. During the battle, Litten Smitten's Incineroar had the type advantage, but was outsmarted by Meowscarada, who had latched some of her Flower Trick's bombs onto its belt. However, after watching Captain Pikachu, Liko, and Roy calm down some enraged Fearow and Dodrio that were chasing Ult, Litten Smitten realized they weren't bad people and decided to trust them. She also admitted that her comment was just a lie and that it was meant to draw Liko out so she could meet her in person, since she was aware of how Liko used to be a regular commenter on Nidothing's streams. After receiving some encouragement from Nidothing and befriending Liko and Roy, Litten Smitten said she would support the Rising Volt Tacklers before she parted ways with them.

She later appeared in Levincia during the Nidothing and Iono Collaboration to participate in the handshake event.
